chunks: Thus Iblis found his supposition about them to be true; and except for a section of believers they follow him.
ai.seo_question: Who did Iblis fail to lead astray according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Saba underscores the efficacy of Iblis's initial claim that humans are inherently prone to disobedience, a claim validated by the majority's adherence to him. It highlights the 'fariq' (distinct group) of believers who, through divine grace and conscious choice, resisted this universal trend, serving as a model of steadfastness (istiqamah) amidst widespread deviation.
